title: ShEx schema satisfied
intent: Real ShEx schema plus a real shape map, exercising the SEMANTICALLY_VALID hop of the S41 prefix. Both files use the encodings praxis-graphlaw's wasm path actually accepts, established by reading the engine rather than assuming: the schema is ShExJ (validate_shex_native/3 does serde_json::from_str into its own ShExJ AST, so the ShExC front end is not reachable from the wasm boundary) and the shape map is the JSON array-of-pairs form parse_shape_map/1 requires. Two earlier revisions of this vector used ShExC and the compact shapemap syntax; both runtimes agreed on the resulting parse-error refusals, which was real conformance evidence but tested the error path rather than ShEx.
